notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
"Phyrexian" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be a Phyrexian due to Arcane Adaptation.
Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating an Incubator artifact token with two +1/+1 counters on it.
The Incubator enters the battlefield as a 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creature due to March of the Machines and Arcane Adaptation.
Repeat from step 2.
